interaction_rules: Bet/Raise slider syncs bidirectionally with numeric input; invalid values auto-clamped with shake animation
Single-click executes Fold/Check/Call; Bet/Raise requires amount then confirm; All-in requires 300ms hold-press
Invalid action shows inline toast above action bar with auto-dismiss 3s
Solver timeout (>5s) falls back to approximation with precision disclaimer badge
IndexedDB failure shows non-blocking warning toast; game continues
Empty hand history shows illustration with prompt to play first hand
Table init uses skeleton loader; BOT thinking shows animated ellipsis bubble (0.5-2s delay)
First WASM load shows progress bar; subsequent solves show subtle spinner on GTO panel
Mid-hand navigation triggers confirmation modal: Fold and leave or Cancel
Session state persists via IndexedDB checkpoint; resume or start new on return
Precision disclaimer shown as inline pill badge with hover tooltip for simplified calculations
Desktop only: minimum 1024px width; below shows desktop-only message
Global footer on GTO screens: For learning purposes only
